description: Construction of a single storey in fill extension, increase in height of existing single storey rear projection, dormer roof extension to rear with extension above two storey outrigger and installation of 2 roof lights to front (amended description).
decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted shall begin not later than the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and thereafter maintained as such for the lifetime of the development: - drawing numbers 2510(EX)001 Rev P1 dated 18th September 2025, 2410(00)100 Rev P1, 2410(00)300 Rev P1 dated 7th October 2025 and 2410(00)200 Rev P3 dated 23rd October 2025.

The materials to be used for the external surfaces of the extension(s) hereby permitted shall match those specified in the design and access statement dated September 2025 and shall thereafter be retained as such for the lifetime of the development.

<p>The flat roof area of the extension(s) hereby approved shall be accessed for the purpose of maintenance only and shall not be used as a terrace/balcony nor access provided over for use as amenity space at any time.</p>
